create_config_default: create a Glm4MoeLiteConfig with default model parameters for the zai-org/GLM-4.5 checkpoint
create_config_custom: create a Glm4MoeLiteConfig with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and num_attention_heads
build_config_from_dict: build a Glm4MoeLiteConfig from a dictionary of model parameters
review_config_moe_settings: review the Glm4MoeLiteConfig MoE settings including n_routed_experts, num_experts_per_tok, and routed_scaling_factor
summarize_config_attributes: summarize the Glm4MoeLiteConfig attribute_map mappings from num_local_experts to n_routed_experts and head_dim to qk_rope_head_dim
